title: Getting US dollars in Saigon
sub: Where to buy USD cash with dong, near Wink, Nov 2026
tip: ATMs here give dong only, so you can't just withdraw dollars. Take out dong, then buy USD at a gold shop by Ben Thanh (quickest, no paperwork) or at a bank (passport, and they may want your onward ticket). Ask for crisp $100s, count them at the counter, and check the buy/sell board first. Swapping money with people on the street is illegal and full of fakes.
area: District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

home.name: Wink Hotel Saigon Centre
home.addr: 75 Nguyễn Bỉnh Khiêm, Đa Kao, District 1

places.name: Hà Tâm gold shop
notes: Best-known exchange in town, locals and expats both rate it
Sells USD as well as buying it, rates on the board
Mai Văn next door (1 Nguyễn An Ninh) is a backup if the queue's long
Pin is the market; the shop faces it on Nguyễn An Ninh
places.addr: 2 Nguyễn An Ninh, Bến Thành, District 1

places.name: Eximbank exchange counter 59
notes: Proper licensed bank counter that buys and sells USD
Long hours (reported 7am–10pm daily); rates a bit worse than the gold shops
Pin is Đồng Khởi street, not the exact door

places.name: Vietcombank HCMC branch
notes: Big state bank: safest option for a larger amount
Bring your passport and onward flight; selling USD to tourists needs paperwork and they may say no
